briefdescription.para: Raw username/password pair parsed from a login request body.

detaileddescription.para: Held only until the slow password work is dispatched to the password worker.

These are ordinary non-optional strings because a login request must have both values for parsing to succeed. The check that both keys exist is done by GateKeeper::parse_credentials before this struct is built, so by the time a Credentials object exists its fields are known to be present. It is a small value type on purpose: it gets moved into a lambda that runs on a worker thread, so keeping it cheap to copy/move avoids extra work.
